$comment: Required VITE_* env vars for every desktop-2 build. Consumed by scripts/assert-env.mjs which runs as beforeBuildCommand + as a CI step. Each entry: name = env var, shape = optional prefix pattern (space-separated alternatives). Missing var or shape mismatch exits 1 without echoing values.

required.name: VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
required.why: Vite bakes VITE_* at build time. Empty value → ClerkProvider mounts with "" and crashes on boot (v2.2.33 fire).

required.name: VITE_BACKEND_URL
required.why: Points shipped app at prod backend. Missing → dev fallback ships in installer.
